rationale: Phenotype-to-phenotype aggregation, not a molecular edge, so it carries no evidence and must never be presented as biologically evidenced. Reverting to the v0.2.0 form that reads E_RECEPTIVE_SURFACE was considered and rejected: it is dynamically inert, because E_PAEP equals E_SECRETORY_STATE and E_RECEPTIVE_SURFACE implies E_GP130_STAT3 implies E_LIF implies E_SECRETORY_STATE, so OUT_EPITHELIAL_RECEPTIVE is identically E_RECEPTIVE_SURFACE; and it would narrow the perturbation surface by leaving PAEP with no path to adhesion. Supersedes LE081, see PAR-005.

Third disjunct of E_ITGAVB3_5 = E_LIF or E_HBEGF or E_SECRETORY_STATE. Both sibling disjuncts are curated and this one is absent from the catalog, so it is an isolated omission rather than design. Progesterone is not a verified direct inducer of ITGB3: REF-007 (PMID 11600576, Lessey group) reports osteopontin induced by progesterone while the beta3 subunit is induced by EGF or HB-EGF, and PMID 18647810 found no integrin difference across a fourfold progesterone dose. Removing the disjunct was tested and does NOT repair the defect, because E_HBEGF is identically E_SECRETORY_STATE and the integrin node reaches the outputs only through a gate that already requires E_LIF; verified inert over all 262144 input assignments. A real fix needs independent content for E_HBEGF plus de-duplication of the E_RECEPTIVE_SURFACE OR-group, which is a separate increment. Corroborated 2026-07-29 by REF-058 (Somkuti 1997, PMID 9215293), now full text in the corpus: in Ishikawa, 6-day CONTINUOUS E2 lowers surface beta3 by about 52 percent and E2 plus P4 by about 71 percent, while EGF, TGFA and bFGF each raise it and override the steroid suppression. This is the direct primary measurement behind the no-verified-progesterone-induction position above, and it also confirms the EGF half of REF-007's claim; it does NOT license flipping or deleting the disjunct. Two limits keep it context-dependent rather than decisive: it measures the beta3 SUBUNIT only (ITGAV and ITGB5 never measured, heterodimer specificity asserted by citation), and the paper's own Discussion argues in vivo alphavbeta3 rises only AFTER epithelial ER and PR are downregulated - a sequence a continuously steroid-replete culture cannot produce and this model does not represent, since E_PGR is permanently ON under progestin. It strengthens the case for the already-declared action_required.

Hormone driver of a node new in v0.3.0; both sibling conjuncts are curated. Lost because the three-term rule was hand-transcribed into build_superset_rules while NEW_EXECUTABLE_EDGES received only two of its three dependencies. Claim-level support exists but is mouse-only and contradicts the current placement: PMID 9177253, 20974921 and 28827707 establish that estradiol drives uterine epithelial proliferation paracrinely through stromal ERalpha, and that epithelial ERalpha is neither necessary nor sufficient. Curating it onto the epithelial node as a direct conjunct would record the epithelial-autonomous route those papers falsify, so curation is deferred until the rule routes E2 through the stromal FGF relay.

cAMP arm of the decidualization gate; siblings S_PGR and S_NR2F2 are both curated. Two limitations are recorded rather than curated away. First, the evidence isolates cAMP and not PKA: PMID 38060684 uses 8-bromo-cAMP in human endometrial stromal fibroblasts and performs no PKA or CREB perturbation, so EPAC/RAPGEF signalling is not excluded, and no PKA-isolating source was located. Second, the dependency is logically inert: S_NR2F2 is identically S_PGR, so it absorbs the S_PGR and S_PKA disjunct entirely, and replacing the rule with S_BMP2 = S_NR2F2 changes no node in any of 262144 states. A curated row here would assert a relation that no perturbation experiment could test as the network currently stands. Renaming the node to cAMP was considered and rejected: the dictionary semantics are already cAMP-linked, and the rename would rewrite every cfg to relabel an inert edge.

Edge LE081, inherited from adoc-literature-v0.2.0, where the epithelial permissive contribution entered adhesion competence directly. v0.3.0 introduced OUT_EPITHELIAL_RECEPTIVE = E_RECEPTIVE_SURFACE and E_PAEP and rewrote the competence rule to read it, in build_superset_rules, without updating the relation table. The biological claim survives one level up; the row did not follow. Its eight assertions are retained in full and excluded from active coverage. They must never be re-pointed at the migrated relation: all eight test LIF/GP130-STAT3-driven surface remodelling and none tests PAEP, which is the only thing the migrated source node adds. The same eight-reference block is replicated verbatim on LE007, LE008, LE025, LE076 and LE091, so retirement loses no unique evidence.
